name: npr-test_goo_screenspace_info_viewport_parity
purpose: Verify Screen Space Info previous-layer color and depth in explicit OpenGL and Vulkan renders, plus stable Vulkan Rendered viewport sessions for Dithered materials with raytracing disabled and enabled.
passCriteria: Scene Color reads the red object behind the foreground material, Scene Depth is non-black, all objects use the asserted intended material, both requested backends are confirmed, both Vulkan Rendered viewport sessions complete, and no child reports missing bindings, GPU validation failures, VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST, native crashes, or timeouts.
